jobs.occupation: ASIYE GROUP ApS søger nye kollegaer: Koordinator/Chauffør & Chauffør (Kørekort B) / ASIYE GROUP ApS is hiring: Coordinator/Driver & Driver (Driver's License B)
jobs.description:
ASIYE GROUP ApS søger nye kollegaer: Koordinator/Chauffør & Chauffør (Kørekort B)

ASIYE GROUP ApS oplever fortsat vækst, og vi udvider nu vores team. Vi søger to engagerede, ansvarsfulde og stabile profiler til vores transport- og logistikdrift: En struktureret koordinator (med aktiv kørsel) og en professionel chauffør. Begge stillinger kræver almindeligt kørekort (Kategori B), samt at du behersker tyrkisk og engelsk.

Vi tilbyder en dynamisk hverdag i en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor kvalitet og højt serviceniveau er i højsædet. Læs mere om de to stillinger nedenfor og angiv i din ansøgning, hvilken rolle du søger.

PROFIL 1: Teamkoordinator & Chauffør (Hybridstilling)

Som vores nye koordinator bliver du omdrejningspunktet for den daglige drift. Du får ansvaret for at planlægge arbejdet for vores chauffører, men du er også en aktiv del af flåden og træder selv til bag rattet.

Dine primære opgaver:

• 
Planlægning og koordinering: Daglig ruteplanlægning og opgavestyring for selskabets ansatte chauffører.

• 
Kvalitetssikring i marken: Køre periodisk med chaufførerne for at evaluere, vejlede og sikre vores høje kvalitetsstandarder.

• 
Aktiv kørsel: Selvom du har administrative opgaver, fungerer du også som aktiv chauffør (Kørekort B) i det daglige og i travle perioder.

• 
Administrative opgaver: Håndtering af ad-hoc administrative opgaver relateret til driften.

• 
Sparring og support: Fungere som primær kontaktperson, guide og motivator for chaufførteamet.

Vores forventninger til dig:

• 
Sprogkundskaber: Du skal kunne kommunikere flydende på tyrkisk og engelsk i både skrift og tale af hensyn til vores interne koordinering og samarbejdspartnere.

• 
Erfaring med logistik, koordinering eller teamledelse (erfaring fra transportbranchen er en stor fordel).

• 
Struktureret, løsningsorienteret og i stand til at bevare overblikket i pressede situationer.

• 
Gyldigt kørekort (B) og erfaring som aktiv, rutineret bilist.

PROFIL 2: Chauffør (Kørekort B)

Vi søger en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der vil være virksomhedens ansigt udadtil over for vores kunder. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores daglige leveringsteam.

Dine primære opgaver:

• 
Transport og levering: Sikker og effektiv afvikling af de planlagte ruter i selskabets biler (Kategori B).

• 
Kundeservice: Sikre at varer/ydelser leveres til tiden og altid med et højt serviceniveau og et smil.

• 
Kvalitetsbevidst arbejde: Sørge for at køretøjet holdes pænt, og at gældende retningslinjer for transporten overholdes.

• 
Samarbejde: Tæt dialog med koordinatoren og resten af teamet for at optimere hverdagen.

Vores forventninger til dig:

• 
Sprogkundskaber: Du kan tale og forstå enten tyrkisk eller engelsk på et fornuftigt niveau (og gerne begge dele).

• 
Gyldigt kørekort (B) og solid erfaring med kørsel i varebil eller lignende.

• 
Mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsfuld omkring dine arbejdstider og opgaver.

• 
Præsentabel, høflig og serviceminded over for kunder og kollegaer.

Hvad tilbyder ASIYE GROUP ApS?

• 
En stabil arbejdsplads med gode, engagerede kollegaer.

• 
Gode og professionelle rammer for udførelsen af dit arbejde.

• 
Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling (særligt i koordinatorrollen).

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Er du vores nye koordinator eller chauffør? Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Marker venligst din ansøgning med enten "Ansøgning: Koordinator" eller "Ansøgning: Chauffør".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og besætter stillingerne, så snart de rette kandidater er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte os via ovenstående e-mail, hvorefter vi vil vende tilbage til dig.

 

ASIYE GROUP ApS is hiring: Coordinator/Driver & Driver (Driver's License B)

ASIYE GROUP ApS continues to grow, and we are now expanding our team. We are seeking two dedicated, responsible, and reliable profiles for our transport and logistics operations: A structured coordinator (with active driving) and a professional driver. Both positions require a standard driver's license (Category B), as well as proficiency in Turkish and English.

We offer a dynamic everyday work environment in a developing company where quality and high service levels are paramount. Read more about the two positions below and please specify in your application which role you are applying for.

PROFILE 1: Team Coordinator & Driver (Hybrid Position)

As our new coordinator, you will be the core of our daily operations. You will be responsible for planning the work schedule for our drivers, but you will also be an active part of the fleet and step behind the wheel yourself.

Your primary tasks:

• 
Planning and coordination: Daily route planning and task management for the company's employed drivers.

• 
Quality assurance in the field: Periodically driving with the drivers to evaluate, guide, and ensure our high-quality standards.

• 
Active driving: Even though you have administrative tasks, you will also act as an active driver (License B) on a daily basis and during busy periods.

• 
Administrative tasks: Handling ad-hoc administrative tasks related to operations.

• 
Sparring and support: Acting as the primary contact person, guide, and motivator for the driver team.

Our expectations for you:

• 
Language skills: You must be able to communicate fluently in Turkish and English (both written and spoken) for our internal coordination and business partners.

• 
Experience in logistics, coordination, or team leadership (experience in the transport industry is a major advantage).

• 
Structured, solution-oriented, and able to maintain an overview in high-pressure situations.

• 
Valid driver's license (B) and experience as an active, experienced driver.

PROFILE 2: Driver (Driver's License B)

We are looking for a reliable and service-minded driver who will be the face of the company to our customers. You will become an important part of our daily delivery team.

Your primary tasks:

• 
Transport and delivery: Safe and efficient execution of planned routes in the company's vehicles (Category B).

• 
Customer service: Ensuring that goods/services are delivered on time and always with a high service level and a smile.

• 
Quality-conscious work: Making sure the vehicle is kept clean and tidy, and that applicable regulations for transport are followed.

• 
Collaboration: Close dialogue with the coordinator and the rest of the team to optimize the daily workflow.

Our expectations for you:

• 
Language skills: You can speak and understand either Turkish or English at a reasonable level (and preferably both).

• 
Valid driver's license (B) and solid experience driving vans or similar vehicles.

• 
Punctual, flexible, and responsible regarding your working hours and tasks.

• 
Presentable, polite, and service-minded towards customers and colleagues.

What does ASIYE GROUP ApS offer?

• 
A stable workplace with good, dedicated colleagues.

• 
A professional environment for executing your daily tasks.

• 
Opportunities for personal and professional growth (especially in the coordinator role).

• 
Salary based on qualifications.

Application and contact

Are you our new coordinator or driver? Send your application and CV as soon as possible to zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Please mark your application with either "Application: Coordinator" or "Application: Driver".

We conduct interviews ongoingly and fill the positions as soon as the right candidates are found.

If you have any questions regarding the positions, feel free to contact us via the above email, and we will get back to you.

jobs.occupation: Financial Controller, Associate/Senior Associate
jobs.description:
About the job

Do you thrive in a dynamic group function within an international organisation, working alongside like-minded and passionate colleagues? Do you have a solid foundation in audit or financial controlling and are you ready to take the next step in your career?

Then come join Saxo and play a key role in our financial and regulatory reporting while expanding your expertise in group reporting, IFRS reporting and regulatory reporting.

We are looking for a Financial Controller to join our skilled, dedicated and energetic reporting team of five employees, which is overall responsible for our IFRS Annual Report, including the group controlling and consolidation of more than 10 companies and regulatory reporting. You will be reporting directly to the Head Financial Controlling.

A few words from our Hiring Manager, Head of Financial Controlling, on the exciting position:

“If you enjoy working in a dynamic area, are ambitious in terms of taking on new challenges and developing your financial reporting skills alongside a strong team, this is the position for you. You will work together with a fantastic team. “

Our financial controlling team is responsible for monthly group consolidation and reporting processes, IFRS Group Annual Report and regulatory reporting to the Danish authorities. Further, we are responsible for coordination with the external auditors.

We are working together with Head of Financial Compliance who is our IFRS expert and moreover we work closely with the Commercial Finance team.

Responsibilities

In this role you will be a key player in Saxo’s external reporting procedures spanning from external reporting, optimisation of processes and working with our consolidation system.

To succeed in this role you should be curious, eager to learn and motivated to develop your controlling and reporting skills while contributing to the solving of complex accounting issues with support from experienced colleagues. You will be able to engage in close collaboration with the rest of your team as well as with our many stakeholders throughout a truly international organisation.

Your profile

• 
2-4 years of experience from an auditing firm or working within financial controlling

• 
Experience with complex accounting, reporting or audit engagements, providing exposure to a broad range of financial reporting topics and business environments

• 
Relevant degree in Finance or Accounting (e.g. Bachelor's degree or HD, including candidates currently pursuing an HD degree)

• 
Proficient in English both verbal and written and comfortable navigating an international organisation

• 
Experience in the financial sector is not a prerequisite

Furthermore, we are looking for a candidate who is structured, analytical and self-motivated. Someone with focus on effective problem solving while working with tight deadlines. You are a team player who enjoys collaborating with others and contributing with new perspectives.

Additionally, you have a proactive mindset and are comfortable taking on unfamiliar tasks.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.occupation: C# Software Engineer - Wind Power
jobs.description:
About the Role

Job ID

304683

Location

Denmark

Midtjylland

Brande

Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy A/S

Full-time

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join our High-Performance Development team in Denmark in a role focused on Improving and maintaining our power plant control software solution that is deployed to SGRE wind farms all over the world.

Your day may start with investigating a support case, perform remote troubleshooting and conduct detailed event analysis of power plant operations to identify and resolve software or configuration issues.

Afterwards you would resume to your regular software development task in the agile development team, with daily scrums and develop high-quality code including unit- and automated integration tests to ensure correct behavior.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Develop/maintain. C# .NET based platform that supports real-time control

• Design and develop data services that serve, process and store large data amounts within wind farms.

• Relentless focus on cyber solutions.

• Develop configuration validation, monitoring and tooling

• Clarify and mature requirements

• Contribute to planning

What You Bring

• Bachelors or Masters degree in Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, preferably combined with relevant professional engineering experience.

• C# and automated testing.  Experience with CI/CD practices, agile development methodologies, C++ and Python language experience is appreciated as well.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, cybersecurity principles, and secure system integration, including areas such as PKI certificates, authentication mechanisms, secure communication interfaces, or IEC 62443-based environments.

About the Team

You will join the Development team in Denmark, where Software Developer/Engineers collaborate to constantly improve wind farm control and power plant solutions.

Knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and open collaboration are an integral part of the team's way of working. While the role offers a high degree of ownership and independent responsibility, you will be supported by experienced colleagues who work together to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver trusted measurement solutions.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Competitive compensation package

• Work-life balance: Flexible working time

• Flexible mobile working policy (hybrid)

• Local benefits such as meal allowance, flexible plan and much more

• Self-driven development framework with insights and resources to develop and grow on technical and soft skills. Continuous learning

• International and cross Business Units

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: KPMG TechAcademy 2027
jobs.description:
Solve business challenges with AI alongside industry-leading experts

KPMG TechAcademy is an intensive, hands-on program for motivated students who want to explore how technology, AI and consulting come together to solve real business challenges.

Are you curious about:

• How AI can solve real business challenges?

• How consultants turn complex problems into actionable solutions?

• How to build and test AI-powered prototypes?

• How technology creates measurable business value?

• How the next generation of consulting is being shaped by AI?

If so, TechAcademy is the place for you! Join us to explore:

• The latest technologies used to solve real-world business and client challenges.

• Deep insights into new technologies and their impact.

• What it’s like to work at KPMG NewTech and in Management Consulting.

• The future of work and the skills you’ll need to thrive.

• How to move from best practices to NewPractice: shifting from human scaling to tech scaling.

Why join TechAcademy?

Throughout TechAcademy, you will work in a team on one shared, client-relevant case. You will receive business context, stakeholder perspectives, data and constraints, but you will not be given the answer.

It will be up to your team to identify the most valuable opportunity, select a solution worth pursuing and demonstrate why it can create an impact.

Along the way, you will receive inspiration, practical tools and sparring from KPMG NewTech professionals with experience in technology, AI and consulting. The program is designed to give you a realistic view of how we work with complex client challenges at KPMG NewTech.

Who are we looking for?

• TechAcademy is open to all university students (bachelor’s or master’s level), regardless of your field of study.

• You don’t need a tech background, what matters most is your interest in learning and genuine curiosity about technology. Skills can be taught, but interest in learning is key.

• Permanent residency in Copenhagen is required.

Practical information:

Format: Four evening sessions from 16:00-21:00

Location: KPMG, Copenhagen

Participation: Attendance and active participation are expected across all four sessions

Included: Dinner, refreshments, materials and access to relevant tools during the sessions

Session dates

• Session 1: 4 March, 2027

• Session 2: 18 March, 2027

• Session 3: 8 April, 2027

• Session 4 and finale: 23 April, 2027

Application:

To apply, submit a motivational letter or video as well as CV and grade transcripts no later than 30 November, 2026.

In your motivational letter, you should answer the following questions, max 1 page:

• Why would you like to participate in KPMG TechAcademy?

• What do you hope to learn or gain from the program?

• What makes you a strong candidate for TechAcademy?

You may draw on experiences from your studies, work, volunteering, student organisations or personal projects.

We expect to provide feedback to all applicants during December 2026 or January 2027.

We look forward to receiving your application!

KPMG is a global network of professional services firms providing Audit, Tax and Advisory services. We operate in 142 countries and have over 275,000 people working in member firms around the world. We work closely with a broad range of clients, such as business corporations, governments and public sector agencies and not-for-profit organisations. We support them in mitigating risks and exploiting business opportunities.

KPMG in Denmark is one of the fastest-growing professional services companies in Denmark, achieving 1.6 billion DKK in revenue in FY25. Together, over 600 employees and partners help our customers ignite their potential. By combining our global vision with comprehensive local knowledge, we create long-term value with a responsible use of technology with a human touch.

jobs.occupation: Senior OT Incident Engineer
jobs.description:
Imagine a future where you safeguard the stability and resilience of operational technology systems that underpin offshore and onshore renewable energy generation.

Why join?

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

**Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

**You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

You’ll play an important role in:

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr81,720.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Process consultant - Viby DK
jobs.description:
Would you like to turn complex procurement processes into practical digital solutions that create measurable business value? And are you motivated by working at the intersection of business, process improvement and technology?

“As our new Senior Business Process Consultant, you will connect business needs with digital opportunities within Procurement. You will join our Digital S2C Excellence team, part of Procurement Data and Digital Excellence, where you will work across Procurement, business functions and digital teams to improve the way we work and help translate business requirements into effective processes and solutions”, says Anette Falk Bøgebjerg, Head of Data & Digital Excellence for Procurement.

How you will make an impact

Reporting to the Head of Digital S2C Excellence, you will play an important role in developing and improving Arla's source-to-contract and procure-to-pay processes. Combining process knowledge, data and stakeholder insights, you will identify improvement opportunities, help design solutions and support their implementation across the organisation.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Facilitate business process improvements and collaborate with stakeholders to define and document clear objectives, requirements and opportunities for improvement.

• Analyse process and performance data to identify trends, challenge existing ways of working and recommend improvements.

• Design process and digital solutions that support business priorities, working closely with Digital Business Consultants and relevant Procurement and business teams.

• Maintain high-quality process documentation, define and monitor performance metrics and ensure alignment with Arla's process framework.

• Support change management, stakeholder training and the successful handover of improved processes to operational teams.

What will make you successful

For this role, we are looking for someone with 2-3 years of Procurement category knowledge and preferably an understanding of Source-to-Pay processes.

You have a Master’s degree in Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field, are interested in how digital solutions and data can enable better ways of working, and you are comfortable turning business requirements and analysis into practical recommendations. LEAN background would be an advantage.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters is that you bring solid knowledge about source to contract processes and are motivated to develop your expertise further in a complex, international Procurement environment.

To succeed in the role, you:

• Approach complex challenges with curiosity and use data and critical thinking to understand problems and identify practical solutions.

• Build constructive relationships across functions and can communicate requirements and ideas clearly to different stakeholders.

• Take ownership of your work while actively collaborating with others to create improvements that work in practice.

As Arla is an international organisation, professional proficiency in English is required.

What do we offer?

You will become part of Digital S2C Excellence within Procurement Data and Digital Excellence in Aarhus. The team has adopted agile ways of working and you will work in an  environment where business expertise, data and digital capabilities come together to improve the way Procurement operates.

The position offers an opportunity to build your expertise in business process management and digital transformation while working with colleagues across functions and geographies. You will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful improvements while developing your professional capabilities within a global organisation.

We are committed to professional development and creating a collaborative environment where colleagues share knowledge and support each other in delivering results. You will join a global, farmer-owned dairy cooperative working to create value for our customers, our farmer owners and the wider world.

Would you like to join us?

If you would like to combine your category experience and business process skills with data and digital solutions to help shape the future of Procurement at Arla, we would be pleased to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we will process applications on a continuous basis and close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information about the position, please contact Head of Data & Digital Excellence, Anette Falk Bøgebjerg at anefb@arlafoods.com

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Senior OT Incident Engineer
jobs.description:
Imagine a future where you safeguard the stability and resilience of operational technology systems that underpin offshore and onshore renewable energy generation.

Application deadline 13 November 2026 , 23:59 CET

Why join?

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

**Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

**You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

You’ll play an important role in:

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr81,720.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

jobs.occupation: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
About the job

At Saxo, we believe access to global capital markets should be simple and accessible. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will play a key role in supporting Saxo's continued growth, innovation and strategic ambitions.

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will provide trusted legal advice across a broad range of business initiatives, regulatory developments, corporate matters, commercial activities, governance matters and strategic projects. Working closely with stakeholders across our offices in both Denmark and abroad, you will help ensure that legal considerations enable business success while maintaining the highest standards of governance, integrity and regulatory compliance.

This role combines strong legal expertise with stakeholder management and business partnership. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will act as a trusted advisor across Saxo, providing pragmatic legal guidance and partnering with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation to navigate legal complexity and support informed decision-making.

Responsibilities

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will:

• Provide strategic legal advice to key stakeholders across Saxo.

• Support commercial, corporate, governance and regulatory matters affecting the business.

• Advise on marketing activities, customer communications, commercial partnerships and strategic business initiatives.

• Partner with business stakeholders to ensure legal risks are appropriately identified and managed.

• Support product development, business expansion initiatives and corporate projects.

• Contribute to effective legal governance frameworks and decision-making processes.

• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Risk Management, Internal Audit and other control functions.

• Manage relationships with external counsel and legal service providers.

• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of relevant legal and regulatory requirements.

• Contribute to the continuous development of the Legal function and strengthen its role as a proactive business partner.

Your profile

You are an experienced legal professional with a strong legal foundation and a proven ability to navigate complex business challenges in a highly regulated environment.

You bring solid legal expertise, sound commercial judgement and the credibility to serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the organisation. You are comfortable balancing legal risk with business priorities and have a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to legal advisory.

To succeed in this role, you will preferably have:

• A master's degree in law or an equivalent legal qualification.

• Solidlegal experience preferably gained either within the financial services industry or at a leading law firm advising clients in regulated sectors.

• Understanding of the legal and regulatory framework governing financial institutions and financial markets.

• Experience advising business stakeholders on legal matters in relation to strategic initiatives and commercial matters.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal matters into practical business advice.

• A proactive, commercially minded and collaborative approach.

Beyond your technical legal capabilities, you are a trusted business partner who builds strong relationships across the organisation and enables informed decision-making while maintaining a high standard of legal governance and integrity.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.occupation: Kellner gesucht
jobs.description:
Für das Hotel Hesselet wird ein Kellner gesucht.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, ein neues Restauranterlebnis im Hotel Hesselet zu eröffnen? Am 1. März 2027 eröffnen wir das Restaurant Hi – ein neu erbautes Pavillonrestaurant im Hotel Hesselet, das als exklusives kulinarisches Universum mit offener Küche, einladendem Ambiente und einem starken Fokus auf Gastfreundschaft, Kultur und ganzheitliche Erlebnisse geschaffen wurde.

Das Hotel Hesselet liegt an einem der schönsten Orte Fünens. Direkt dort, wo der Wald auf das Meer trifft und man die Brücke zwischen Seeland und Fünen sehen kann. Das Hotel befindet sich in Nyborg, das im Mittelalter der Treffpunkt des Königs mit den wichtigsten Persönlichkeiten des Reiches war. Heute ist das Hotel ein Ort der Begegnung, an dem Gastfreundschaft zur Geborgenheit wird.

Das Hotel ist nach dem Wald benannt, in dem es liegt. Hesselet bedeutet „Ort, wo die kleinen Haselnusssträucher wachsen“. Wir sind stolz darauf, zu Dänemarks beliebtesten Strandhotels zu gehören und bemühen uns, all unseren Gästen ein außergewöhnliches Erlebnis zu bieten – egal ob sie bei uns übernachten, speisen oder an einer Konferenz teilnehmen.

Das Hotel Hesselet verändert sich – und ist in guten Händen

Im Jahr 2024 wurde das Hotel Hesselet vom Carama Family Office übernommen, das eine klare Vision verfolgt: die Seele von Hesselet zu bewahren und gleichzeitig das Hotel für zukünftige Gästeerlebnisse weiterzuentwickeln – ohne dabei die Geschichte und die Wärme des Ortes zu beeinträchtigen.

Die neuen Eigentümer haben mit einer behutsamen Renovierung der Hoteleinrichtungen, des Restaurants und der Außenanlagen begonnen. Es wird sowohl in das Ambiente als auch in die Mitarbeiter investiert – mit einem starken Fokus auf Professionalität, Wohlbefinden und erstklassigen Service.

Das Ziel ist ambitioniert, aber klar: Das Hotel Hesselet soll zu den attraktivsten Hotels Dänemarks zählen – sowohl für Gäste als auch für Mitarbeiter. Hier soll man die besondere Ruhe, Qualität und Atmosphäre spüren können, für die Hesselet seit 1967 bekannt ist – in einer zeitgemäßen und modernen Interpretation.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, exzellenten Service und großartige Gästeerlebnisse zu bieten?

Wir suchen einen Kellner, der Teil eines kompetenten Teams werden möchte, in dem stolze Traditionen, hohe Qualität und eine gute Atmosphäre Hand in Hand gehen.

Als Teil unseres Servicepersonals arbeiten Sie in unserem Restaurant, in Veranstaltungsräumen und bei Konferenzen.

Sie werden ein wichtiger Bestandteil des Gästeerlebnisses sein – vom Frühstück und Mittagessen bis zum Abendservice und besonderen Veranstaltungen.

Wir bieten:

• Ein starkes, engagiertes Team mit tollen Kollegen und einem Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit

• Ein Arbeitsplatz mit hohem Serviceniveau und vielen Stammkunden

• Möglichkeit zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und Übernahme von Verantwortung

• Ein abwechslungsreicher Alltag mit alltäglichen Gästen, Partys und Treffen

• Eine fantastische Lage und ein Haus mit Seele und Geschichte

Wir erwarten von Ihnen Folgendes:

• Er ist ein Kellner und legt großen Wert auf guten Service und Gastfreundschaft.

• Behalten Sie den Überblick, bleiben Sie ruhig und lächeln Sie – auch wenn es mal hektisch zugeht.

• Ist flexibel und kann Termine einhalten

• Blüht in Teamarbeit auf, kann aber auch selbstständig Verantwortung übernehmen.

• Ich interessiere mich für Wein, Essen und Gästeerlebnisse.

Arbeitsumfeld

Im Hotel Hesselet pflegen wir eine herzliche, familiäre und freundschaftliche Atmosphäre – sowohl unter Kollegen als auch gegenüber unseren Gästen. Wir sind überzeugt, dass die besten Ergebnisse durch echte Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Präsenz und Interesse entstehen.

Wir erwarten von Ihnen, dass Sie Ihre Persönlichkeit, Ihre Energie und Ihr Engagement einbringen – sowohl in Ihrer Arbeit als auch im Umgang mit Kollegen und Gästen. Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem wir uns gegenseitig unterstützen und als Team zusammenarbeiten, wobei Wohlbefinden und Erfolg gleichermaßen im Fokus stehen.

Wir arbeiten intensiv daran, einen der besten Arbeitsplätze der Branche in Dänemark zu schaffen – und als Teil unseres Serviceteams werden Sie Teil eines engagierten und dynamischen Unternehmens mit ambitionierten Zielen und hoher Professionalität. Wir bieten gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein gesundes Arbeitsumfeld und viel Raum, um mit den Aufgaben zu wachsen.

Gehalt und Konditionen

Gehalt nach Qualifikation. Zusätzlich bieten wir Altersvorsorge, Krankenversicherung und weitere Beschäftigungsbedingungen gemäß Tarifvertrag und gegebenenfalls weiterer Vereinbarung. Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle mit frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin oder nach Vereinbarung.

Senden Sie Ihre Bewerbung und Ihren Lebenslauf an unseren Restaurantleiter Rasmus Weimar unter rasmus@hesselet.dk – am besten so bald wie möglich, da wir laufend Vorstellungsgespräche führen.

Sollten Sie Fragen zur Stelle haben, können Sie ihn gerne direkt unter der Telefonnummer (45) 65 31 30 29 kontaktieren.

Klingt das nach etwas, von dem Sie gerne hören würden? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören.

jobs.description:
Job description

Do you want to build intelligent software that powers the future of sports coaching? Are you passionate about transforming raw data and AI model predictions into meaningful, real-world metrics for professional American football players? Then come and join our ambitious and collaborative product team!

Data is revolutionizing sports. Join our team to play.

This is a great opportunity to join our growing New Sports team within our Tracking Department. Our team is responsible for the development of the firmware for our American football products. We are developing cutting-edge solutions that leverage deep learning, classic computer vision, machine learning, and signal processing algorithms to deliver product features. Through our market leading radar and computer vision-based tracking technology, we are building products used by some of the best athletes in the world.

Example projects we are working on:

• 
Detecting and tracking objects, such as balls, players, and clubs, across several different sports

• 
Optical flow for determining ball flight characteristics

• 
Calibration between radar and camera data for drawing tracks in broadcast television

• 
Human pose tracking for analyzing athlete performance

Are you our new colleague?

Our ideal candidate is specialized the area of computer vision and machine learning. You will be joining a team of specialists within these fields and together we strive to remain the best in the world at what we do. Your responsibilities will include development of new and existing products and core processes based on your experience and skills.

In the new sports team we value teamwork and openness. Therefore, we expect you to enjoy working with other highly motivated colleagues and help provide a good working environment. We do not expect that you can be an expert on every aspect of being a developer, but rather strive to improve and learn together with the team.

Responsibilities:

• 
Develop advanced DL, ML, classic computer vision, algorithms.

• 
Write production ready code, with emphasis on deployment, monitoring and supportability

• 
Design and execute experiments to acquire and prepare datasets for algorithm development

• 
Develop and extend tooling for computer vision development. This can include data visualization, annotation and debugging

• 
Develop appropriate system architecture for edge-based and server solutions

• 
Collaborate with engineers within Vision & AI and the tracking department to produce high quality cutting edge systems

Job requirements

• 
Master’s Degree or Ph.D. in computer vision, machine learning, computer science, mathematical modelling, or equivalent

• 
3+ years of practical experience in implementing and deploying computer vision systems, with a proven track record of successful project execution and system optimization

• 
Strong software development and programming skills within Python and C++

• 
Experienced in computer vision techniques, including object detection, video tracking, and image analysis, as well as deep learning and convolutional neural networks in machine learning

• 
You have an entrepreneurial mindset and thrive on taking an idea from concept to a polished implementation.

jobs.occupation: Student Software Developer
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy understanding how things work, spotting inefficiencies and finding better ways to solve problems? Would you like the software you build to matter in real time? Then you might be our next Student Software Developer.

At Nitor Energy, software isn’t a support function – it’s at the core of how we trade. You’ll join our software team and help build the tools and systems that traders and analysts use every day. You’ll get meaningful responsibility early, support from experienced developers and hands-on exposure to a fast-moving business, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time role.

Direct collaboration. No middlemen.

We believe the best solutions are built by people who understand the problem firsthand. That’s why we work without unnecessary handoffs or translation layers: developers talk directly to traders, analysts and the colleagues who use what they build.

As a student, you’ll be part of these conversations, learning to ask good questions, test ideas, get feedback quickly and see the impact of your work.

What you’ll be doing

• Build and improve internal trading systems, analytical tools, dashboards and alerts alongside experienced developers.

• Integrate, process and make market data available from external vendors.

• Take on well-scoped development tasks, from understanding requirements to implementation, testing, review and deployment.

• Work directly with traders and analysts to understand their workflows, gather feedback and iterate on solutions.

• Learn what it takes to build reliable, maintainable software – including shared data models, traceability, performance and system operations.

• Explore approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly and verify the code and outputs you use.

What we’re looking for

• You’re studying for a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, with no more than a year remaining, and are interested in a potential full-time future at Nitor.

• You have good programming fundamentals and a practical, curious approach to solving problems.

• You’ve had exposure to some of our stack – C# (.NET/ASP.NET Core), TypeScript/React, Microsoft SQL, Azure or Python – or are motivated to learn it. You don’t need experience with all of them.

• You enjoy working with others, communicate openly, ask for help when needed and learn from feedback.

• You take responsibility for your tasks, follow through and look for ways to make things better.

What we offer

• Meaningful tasks from day one with close mentoring, regular feedback and room to grow.

• A chance to learn the energy trading domain while contributing to business-critical systems.

• A young, ambitious and social environment where developers, analysts and traders work closely together.

• Competitive pay and a modern office in central Aarhus, right by Dokk1 and the light rail.

• Catered lunch from Meyers, social events and weekly sports activities, including the Nitor running club.

Expected start date: As soon as possible.

Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position early if we find the right candidate.

About Nitor Energy

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.

Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

jobs.occupation: Shape the future of Saab Danmark's jurney towards enhanced customer centricity
jobs.description:
Saab Danmark is entering an exciting phase of growth and transformation. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer (CPO) who can define direction, drive execution, and lead the evolution of our products, technology, and product organization. You will play a key role in strengthening our product platform, advancing our digital capabilities, and positioning Saab Danmark for sustainable long-term growth.

Reporting to the CEO and serving as a member of the Danish Management Team, you will hold overall responsibility for Saab Danmark's Product Organization, including Product Management and Product Development across Software, Hardware, Systems Engineering, and Testing.

As CPO, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Saab Danmark's next chapter. While ensuring successful delivery across an active project portfolio, you will lead the transition towards a stronger product-centric approach, where a scalable core platform enables future innovation, customer solutions, and digital services.

This role requires a leader who can combine strategic vision with operational excellence, create followership across the organization, and unite technology, product development, and business priorities into one coherent direction.

Key responsibilities

• 
Define, maintain, and drive the overall product, technology strategy in alignment with Saab’s vision, business objectives, and future market opportunities.

• 
Develop and execute a product roadmap that balances short-term delivery commitments with long-term product and technology investments.

• 
Lead and develop the Product Organization through Product Management, Software, Hardware, Systems Engineering, and Testing leadership teams.

• 
Strengthen Product Management capabilities and ways of working, ensuring clear ownership of product strategy, portfolio priorities, roadmap decisions, and customer value creation across the organization.

• 
Drive the evolution towards a more software-defined, cloud-enabled, and service-oriented product architecture, translating emerging technologies and digital trends into sustainable customer value.

• 
Ensure alignment between customer needs, business priorities, technology development, and product investments.

• 
Establish and strengthen the core product platform, enabling future customer solutions to be delivered through configuration, extension, and scalable reuse rather than repeated customization.

• 
Foster organizational effectiveness, accountability, and execution across the full product lifecycle.

• 
Build an aligned and high-performing leadership team by creating clarity, strengthening leadership capabilities, and fostering commitment to a shared direction across experienced technical leaders and specialist disciplines.

• 
Ensure clear prioritization of resources and development initiatives across competing demands.

• 
Safeguard the long-term direction, architecture, and integrity of Saab Danmark’s product portfolio.

• 
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, learning, and ownership.

• 
Contribute actively to company strategy and decision-making as a member of the company Management Team.

What you bring

You are an experienced product and technology leader with a strong track record from Product Management, Software Engineering, Product Development, or similarly complex technology-driven environments.

You have successfully led organizations through growth, change, and transformation and know how to create results through clear direction, strong leadership, and effective collaboration.

You are comfortable operating at both strategic and operational levels and have demonstrated the ability to translate ambitious visions into tangible business outcomes.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
Experience from software-centric or software-defined product environments where product strategy, engineering excellence, and customer value creation are closely connected.

• 
Strong experience with Product Management, product strategy, roadmap management, and portfolio prioritization.

• 
A solid understanding of modern software development practices, platform thinking, and cloud technologies.

• 
Experience leading product, platform, cloud, or digital transformation initiatives and translating strategic ambitions into measurable organizational and business outcomes.

• 
Experience balancing the demands of ongoing customer deliveries with the long-term development of scalable products, platforms, and capabilities.

• 
The ability to balance operational delivery with long-term capability building.

• 
A strong commercial mindset combined with a deep appreciation for technology and innovation.

• 
The ability to navigate competing priorities and make clear decisions in complex environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment across diverse functions and leadership levels.

• 
Experience building trust, credibility, and followership in organizations with highly experienced technical leaders and specialists.

• 
Curiosity about emerging technologies and their potential impact on products, services, and business models.

In addition, you must be able to obtain and maintain the security clearance required by Danish Defence Intelligence Service for this position. This typically requires candidates to have resided within a NATO or EU member state for the past seven years.

Who you are

You are a pragmatic leader who combines strategic thinking with operational discipline.

You create clarity in complex environments, make priorities visible, and build followership through professional credibility, sound judgement, and consistent leadership. You are comfortable leading experienced managers and specialists and create alignment and commitment around a shared direction.

Why Saab Danmark?

This is an opportunity to play a defining role in shaping the future of Saab Danmark. You will influence the direction of our products, contribute to company strategy, and help position Saab Danmark for its next stage of growth.

If you are motivated by building great products, shaping organizational direction, and creating lasting business impact, this is an opportunity to play a key role in Saab Danmark's continued development and growth.

For further information about the position, please contact Flemming Klovborg, LOHFF | THORNING Partner at +45 4314 4202. All inquiries will be handled with complete confidentiality.

Applications should be submitted through the application link.

About Saab Danmark A/S

Saab in Denmark is part of the Saab Group with headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden. At the same time, Saab Danmark is an independent legal company with a flat organisational structure. Our main business area is delivering integrated communication solutions to military markets in Denmark and abroad.

jobs.occupation: AIV Planner - help turn spacecraft assembly into a scalable production flow
jobs.description:
In our Satellite Assembly, Integration, and Verification Team, you will be at the center of planning how spacecraft are assembled, integrated, tested, and tracked. You will translate complex AIV activities into executable production flows and system structures, while coordinating the interfaces that make the flow work in practice. If you combine strong systems understanding with structure, initiative, and a drive to build better solutions, this is your opportunity to shape how we manufacture satellites.

About the Position as AIV Planner

As AIV Planner, you will own the planning framework supporting spacecraft assembly and verification. You will establish and maintain production flows, routings, and planning data in our ERP system while coordinating activities across AIV, production, project management, and logistics to ensure efficient execution.

You will play a key role in developing scalable planning processes, improving digital ways of working, and connecting future ERP and MES capabilities to the needs of spacecraft production. Your experience and ideas will directly influence a more controlled, digital, and scalable production flow.

Responsibilities include:

You will ensure that spacecraft build plans are translated into controlled and executable work in our operational systems, while aligning the interfaces needed for reliable AIV execution.

Production Planning and System Execution

• Create and maintain AIV routings, production orders, planning parameters, and relevant production master data in the ERP system.

• Translate engineering structures and AIV plans into practical production sequences with clear dependencies, revisions, effectivity, and material requirements.

• Monitor order progress and data quality, resolve planning issues, and help establish the ERP system as the operational source of truth for spacecraft build execution.

Cross-functional Planning and Material Flow

• Coordinate with Electronic Production, Project Management, AIV, engineering, warehouse, and other planners to align readiness, priorities, materials, and handovers.

• Coordinate AIV inventory and material flow, including allocation, kitting, shortages, transfers, returns, and controlled movement of hardware.

Configuration, Change, and Improvement

• Maintain configuration and traceability in the ERP system, including correct parts, revisions, serial numbers, routings, effectivity, material movements, and as-built status.

• Assist the ECR/ECO process by identifying affected routings and production orders, supporting change-impact assessment, and implementing approved changes in the ERP system with the required traceability.

What you bring

At GomSpace, it’s not just your technical skills that matter - your character is also important. We value individuals who bring a positive, proactive attitude and can build trust across cultures. The ideal candidate will be comfortable taking ownership in an environment that is still being built, combining a strong systems understanding with practical knowledge of production flows and the ability to quickly learn new tools and processes.

You likely:

• Have minimum 3 years of experience in production planning, working with ERP, MES, or similar operational systems. Experience with IFS is a strong plus, but not mandatory.

• Practical understanding of production flows, routings, production orders, material availability, sequencing, and master data.

• Ability to understand system relationships and translate engineering and operational inputs into a clear, executable production flow.

• Experience with configuration management, revision control, serial-number traceability, and as-built records.

• Ability to coordinate across multiple interfaces and turn incomplete or changing inputs into a structured plan.

• Strong drive, ownership, and a solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to establish and improve processes rather than only operate existing ones.

• Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported, and inspired to push boundaries together.

• Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry

• Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us

• Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike

• Work across borders and build a strong international network

• Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

Join our mission

You are welcome to send your application in Danish or English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. Apply for the job by following the link below.

If you have any questions with regard to the position do not hesitate to contact: Simon Holt Olsen, Head of AIV, shol@gomspace.com.

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6, Aalborg, Denmark and it is expected that most of the time is in the offices.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 300 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries. Learn more on www.gomspace.com

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!
